summary: Neopets entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Neopets
entries.definitive_edition: Current Neopets.com live browser site with account, event, NeoPass, and Ruffle state documented

emulation.notes: Use modern browser and official site; record Ruffle/browser compatibility.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official website plus restored classic games where supported

primary.version: Current Neopets.com live site with NeoPass/Ruffle state documented
primary.why: Neopets is a live browser virtual-pet world. The current website is the archive route, while restored Flash-era games through Ruffle and the 2026 Mega Mini Games Collection are related but separate preservation/access paths.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Neopets.com site in a modern browser. Record date, account/NeoPass state, pets, inventory, Neopoints/Neocash, active event/plot, classic game/Ruffle compatibility, browser, and whether Mega Mini Games Collection rewards were linked.

secondary.exclusive_content: Restored minigames from the Flash era
secondary.why: They are part of the site history but depend on Ruffle compatibility.

secondary.exclusive_content: Modern remade minigame collection with NeoPass rewards
secondary.what_to_play: Track as a companion route, not the main site.
secondary.why: It is a curated standalone collection rather than the whole Neopets site.

all_releases.fidelity: Live virtual pet/browser game with account, event, economy, and browser state.
Restored Flash minigames through integrated Ruffle emulator.
Account-linking and standalone remastered minigame collection route.
all_releases.reason: secondary: companion/preservation route, not full-site replacement.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Completeness depends on live account/site/event state, browser compatibility, Ruffle support, and companion collection rewards.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not treat Mega Mini Games Collection as a replacement for the live site.
